findings.title: The status column of the ticket table cannot be scanned

location.description: The Oldest open tickets table, the Status column

findings.viewer_experience: Open, Waiting on customer and Solved are small plain grey words, the same as the surrounding cells, so the viewer must read each row to see which tickets need action.

current.value: The status values are small plain grey text, in the same style as the other cells.

findings.target: The status of each ticket can be told apart at a glance down the column.
findings.fix_direction: Give each status a visible look of its own so the three can be told apart without reading.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics, visibility of system status

closed_when.check: Look at the Status column: each status can be told apart at a glance.

findings.title: The highlighted Monday bar is not explained

location.description: The Tickets by weekday chart in the right card of the middle row

findings.viewer_experience: The Monday bar is dark blue and the rest grey with a number only above it, and nothing says why Monday is picked out.

current.value: One bar is blue with a value and the other six are grey with no value.

findings.target: The viewer can tell why one bar is picked out.
findings.fix_direction: Say in words why Monday is picked out, for example with a short note or label.

closed_when.check: Look at the chart: it is clear why one bar is picked out.
